Match original body, head, dark blue tunic, bronze-edged plate armor, sword, reasonable boots, proportions, poses and lighting. Forearm/hand must attach credibly on its inside. Keep the identical kite-shaped silhouette and modest metal rim. NO blue emblem, NO heraldry on its inside. In prone/death poses keep the inside surface when visible, with proper occlusion. If a shield turns truly edge-on, show a thin rim. Preserve all44 poses, sword position, body identity and full feet. Do not turn the body toward camera. Transparent alpha background, generous separation between every character, no shadows/background, labels, text, new figures or extra rows. Painted restrained earth/steel/blue palette matching original game art.
